root_cause.text: When device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails in sd_probe(), the error handling only calls put_device() (which frees the scsi_disk via scsi_disk_release()) but fails to decrement the reference count on the gendisk (gd), causing a reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "If device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, put_device() runs scsi_disk_release(), which frees the scsi_disk but leaves the gendisk referenced. The device_add_disk() error path in sd_probe() calls put_disk(gd); call put_disk(gd) here to mirror that cleanup." The patch adds `put_disk(gd)` after `put_device(&sdkp->disk_dev)` in the error path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a gendisk reference leak in the scsi disk probe error path when device_add fails.
intent_record.what: Added put_disk(gd) call in the error path of sd_probe when device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, after put_device(&sdkp->disk_dev) and before goto out.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the reference count of the gendisk structure (gd) is decremented when device_add fails, preventing a reference leak that would otherwise leave the gendisk with an elevated refcount.

candidates.rationale: This goto statement jumps to the exit path without releasing the gendisk (gd) reference, causing a reference leak when device_add fails.

vuln_statements.explanation: After device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, the error path jumps to 'out' via this goto without decrementing the reference count on the gendisk (gd), causing a reference leak.

No fix (e.g., adding put_disk(gd) in that error path) is present.
